desc: Read input N and string S, then collect the 0-indexed positions of all '1's into a list `ones_pos`.
Compute the transformed values $q_j = \text{ones\_pos}[j] - j$ for each $j$ from $0$ to $k-1$.
Find the median of the list $q$. Sort $q$ and pick the element at index $k // 2$.
Calculate the total cost as the sum of absolute differences between each $q_j$ and the median.
